name: AIChipHandoff
description: Directional ownership chip visualizing transfer between agents, humans, system triggers, or failed handoffs in a compact inline pill.
intent: Communicate agent-to-agent, agent-to-human, human-to-agent, system-to-agent, and failed handoff transitions in audit trails and table rows.

requiredAttributes: aria-label describing from → to handoff (includes 'failed' when applicable)

usage: Show ownership transfer inline in audit trails, table rows, or timeline summaries
Communicate agent-to-agent delegation without a full timeline step
Indicate human escalation or hand-back in compact form
Mark failed handoff attempts with dashed arrow and red tones
doNotUse: Full handoff narrative with timestamps and rationale — use `AIHandoffTimeline` group
Interactive handoff controls — chip is display-only
Generic directional labels unrelated to AI ownership transfer
Do not use emoji or AI Avatar in place of entity glyphs
Do not use text arrows for failed state — use dashed SVG from bundle
Do not hardcode brand hex for agent-to-agent — use AI tokens and CSS vars

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No well-formed props in the manifest and none extracted from TSX. Not guessed.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
No implementation TSX found next to the spec or under src/components. Recorded as spec-only.
